integrity: The finite formulas and limiting expressions have a complete mathematical argument and a reproducible finite checker. Historical priority and the proof have not undergone independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Independent bond percolation on finite wheels with fixed positive two-rate parameters only; neither general graphs nor other scaling windows are covered. The interior limit distribution is given constructively, without a closed-form density.
title: A two-rate wheel-percolation limit with explicit full-connectivity and hub-mass laws
